baseline.measurement: compact UTF-8 JSON bytes, indented JSON lines, recursive object-key count, and AW command roundtrips

no_active_owner.finding: Absence is explicit and still carries a safe next action and claim boundary.

stale_source_or_recovery.first_line_reason: Stale owner freshness and the failed revision predicate remain first-line.

unresolved_residue.first_line_reason: The unresolved planning follow-up remains the residue owner and blocks broad closure.

external_intent_or_review_blocked.first_line_reason: External-intent and review/topology blockers remain first-line because they change safe resumption.

module_rich.finding: Installed capabilities, Memory, review topology, and diagnostic peers do not become continuation authorities.

projection_disposition.canonical_owner_rule: Summary remains a lossy projection; Planning/current-work sources remain durable owners.

exact_route_proof.assertion: Every continuation_view detail route carries the explicit summarized workspace target; no route falls back to --target .

weak_agent_restart.guidance: For ordinary restart and handoff, continuation_view is authoritative: resume only its owner and next action, preserve freshness, blockers, proof/claim and residue boundaries, and use selectors or verbose output only for optional detail.

mixed_agent_handoff.guidance: For ordinary restart and handoff, continuation_view is authoritative: resume only its owner and next action, preserve freshness, blockers, proof/claim and residue boundaries, and use selectors or verbose output only for optional detail.

handoff_cost.reason: The recorded agent-B trace receives owner, revision, intent, next action, proof freshness, claim boundary, and residue from one continuation_view without chat or raw Planning reconstruction.

shared_invariants: default guidance needs no unconditional follow-up

phase_specific.proof: complete evidence set and receipt sufficiency

cross_surface_review.abstraction_decision: Do not create a universal lifecycle envelope; the proven invariants are vocabulary-level and each phase retains its existing authority and compiler.
